Deep in the Washington desert, the U.S. government built a top-secret nuclear city that would change the world forever. Here, the plutonium for the atomic bomb dropped on Nagasaki was produced. Join me as we get behind-the-scenes access to Hanford, explore its nuclear reactors, talk to the locals, and uncover what remains of this once-secret world.
